title: Gas-phase cis-(egan)IrCl isomer energy comparison
difficulty_reasons: The two molecular identities and endpoints are fixed, but the agent must choose and validate an appropriate electronic-structure protocol for a heavy-element complex.

data.description: Two self-contained 58-atom XYZ geometries for named neutral singlet cis-alpha and cis-beta (egan)IrCl complexes; cis-beta includes the twelve SI hydrogen rows restored from the complete Cartesian table.
Source, repair rationale, original-file hash and repaired-file hash for the cis-beta SI coordinate restoration.

required_deliverables.description: Structured computational results, method, validation, energy difference, ordering, conclusion and limitations.
